explanation: Compared against WOWII Conjecture 61 (status O, open): for connected G, f(G) ≥ res(G) + ⌈diam(G)/3⌉, with f the largest induced forest, res the Havel–Hakimi residue, and diam the diameter (defs 41, 42, 14). The statement matches, using the real ceiling of diam/3; the residue test on K₂ gives 1. Faithful.
